items.title: Flat finite type algebras and flat finite modules over a valuation ring are finitely presented
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that over a valuation ring a flat algebra of finite type is finitely presented and a finite module which is flat over the ring is finitely presented over its algebra. The statement carries a literature reference; the text gives its own proof, which uses the equivalence between flatness and torsion freeness over a valuation ring to homogenise the situation: the algebra and the module are realised as the degree zero parts of a graded algebra of finite type over the ring and a finite graded module over it, torsion parts are removed so that the relevant objects are torsion free, and the corresponding statements for graded algebras and graded modules over a local ring are then applied.
